recognize_zh: 間期 FISH 使用 D7S486（7q31，紅）/CEP7（7 號著絲點，綠）雙色探針，圖中細胞核只見一個紅訊號與一個綠訊號（正常應為各兩個），代表整條 7 號染色體只剩一套，即 monosomy 7。
features: Interphase FISH on DAPI-counterstained nuclei using Vysis D7S486 (7q31, red) / CEP7 (chromosome 7 centromere, green) probes
Evaluable nuclei show a single red and a single green signal (1R1G) instead of the normal 2R2G pattern
Loss of both the centromere and 7q31 signals together indicates loss of a whole chromosome 7 rather than an isolated 7q deletion
Some green signals appear doublet-like, consistent with a split signal of one centromere; an adjacent nucleus in the right panel has no signals in this focal plane and is not evaluable
describe_en: Interphase fluorescence in situ hybridization was performed with a dual-color D7S486 (7q31, red)/CEP7 (green) probe set on DAPI-stained nuclei. The illustrated nuclei show one red and one green signal, compared with the expected two copies of each, indicating concurrent loss of the chromosome 7 centromere and the 7q31 locus. This pattern is consistent with monosomy 7; a 7q deletion alone would show two green signals with one red signal. The percentage of abnormal nuclei should be compared with the laboratory cutoff before reporting a clonal abnormality, and the result is useful for detecting monosomy 7 when metaphases are not obtained in marrow failure or MDS.

ddx.vs: A 7q deletion gives two CEP7 (green) signals with one D7S486 (red) signal (1R2G), whereas both signals are reduced to one here.
Sectioning or overlapping signals can mimic loss in isolated nuclei, so a scored count of 200 or more nuclei above the validated cutoff is needed.
